capabilities: Send the task at the cursor or each selected line to Todoist
Send every open task carrying a marker tag in a note
Convert Obsidian dates, priorities, tags and wikilinks into Todoist syntax
Turn child tasks into subtasks and other child lines into the task description
Check note targets against Todoist projects, sections and labels in a doctor tab
disambiguation: Not a two-way sync tool: it only sends tasks out and leaves a pointer line behind.
extras: Installed by copying main.js, manifest.json and styles.css from a release into the plugins folder; needs Obsidian 1.11.4 or later. The API token is kept in Obsidian's secret storage on each device separately. The plugin talks only to api.todoist.com and has no telemetry.
motivation: Keep roadmaps and checklists in Obsidian and send only the tasks that need a date or a reminder.
problem: Roadmaps and checklists live in Obsidian, but tasks that need a date or a reminder belong in Todoist, and there is no way to hand a single line over.

relations.evidence: moves a task line into Todoist, one way

summary: Sends a task line from Obsidian to Todoist one way, leaving the line as a [>] pointer with a link to the Todoist task.
